zh: 相邻电影的时长要么相同要么加 1，所以一条观影序列一定是从某个时长 t 开始，依次用完 t、t+1、t+2……这些连续时长。
从时长 t 开始时，所有时长为 t 的电影都可以连着看；只有存在时长 t+1 的电影，才能接到下一段。设 best[t]=count[t]+（count[t+1]>0 时的 best[t+1]）。
统计每种时长的数量；按时长从大到小处理，best[t]=count[t]，若 t+1 存在则再加 best[t+1]；答案是所有 best 的最大值。
en: Adjacent movies must have equal runtimes or runtimes that grow by 1, so a viewing sequence starts at some runtime t and uses the consecutive runtimes t, t+1, t+2, and so on.
Starting from runtime t, all movies of runtime t can be watched back to back, and you can move on only if a movie of runtime t+1 exists. Define best[t] = count[t] + best[t+1] when count[t+1] > 0.
Count the movies per runtime; process runtimes from largest to smallest with best[t] = count[t], plus best[t+1] when runtime t+1 exists; the answer is the largest best value.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Count the number of movies of each runtime. If some movie of runtime t+1 exists, then starting from t you can first watch all movies of runtime t and then continue to t+1; otherwise only movies of runtime t can be used.

## Correctness

Starting from runtime t, all movies of runtime t can be watched consecutively; you can move on to the next runtime only when at least one movie of runtime t+1 exists. Each movie is used once, so the transition value is count[t] + best[t+1] (when count[t+1] > 0) and count[t] otherwise. Taking the maximum over every runtime that occurs as a start covers all valid sequences.

## Complexity

With u the number of distinct runtimes, time O(u log u), space O(u).
